source_verification_receipts.locator: Definitions 8–9, Proposition 6, Theorem 1, and Section 6 Discussion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article defines marginal informational completeness, proves identification for Markovian models under local MIC, and identifies extension beyond Markovian models as future work.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 2, “The fixing operation and fixable vertices”; Section 4
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines CADMG fixing as division by the conditional mass given the CADMG Markov blanket, for a supplied kernel, and uses fixing in its identification characterization.
The paper gives a necessary-and-sufficient graphical identification condition and ID algorithm for passive observational input in recursive semi-Markovian models.
The paper establishes the need for observational-law positivity in general identification and presents a sound and complete positivity-aware algorithm.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of the American Statistical Association 119(547), 1778–1793, 2024
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article gives an automated discrete causal-inference approach using polynomial optimization over compatible data-generating processes to produce sharp or containing causal bounds.
The paper reduces discrete-SCM counterfactual bounding to finite canonical SCMs and polynomial programming, with finite exogenous domains.
The paper gives the front-door criterion and its passive-observed-law identifying functional.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add a short equivalence lemma that translates the proposal’s separable effect/state span conditions into Friend et al.’s formal MIC definition, including the full-support input-state clause.
Promote the bow oracle from a fixed graph result to an explicit finite decision procedure over all atomic bow queries, with input encoding and a rank-based complexity bound.

Resolve the one-fixing lift positively or exhibit a smallest explicit algebraic obstruction with a nontrivial finite graph witness; this is the natural route from the field-level bow result toward a broader ADMG contribution.

recommended_next_step: Advance the bow equivalence and explicit menu to Stage 0; retain the one-fixing edge-source realization strictly as the stated open-ended construction problem.
